commands.name: tidia
commands.description: Tidia: status, settings, dictionary, rules, on, off
commands.output: Tidia is on. Tidy on: enter · Style: polish · English terms: auto. Change one: /tidia set <setting> <value> (list: /tidia settings)

tools.name: dictionary
tools.description: Tidia's voice dictionary: spellings the cleanup of the person's voice dictation uses. The person speaks rather than types, so they change it by asking you. dict_add with meant, or heard + meant for a word speech recognition gets wrong; scope global (default) or project. Add one by yourself, without asking, when you are sure a dictated word was misheard (the raw transcript or the person's own correction shows it), then tell the person in one short line. dict_remove takes word. dict_list lists them. Some changes show the person a dialog where they allow or decline them (a pair whose misheard word they did not dictate recently or that does not sound like the spelling, a word they did not dictate, changing or removing an entry you did not add, and every change when they chose to be asked): call the action and do not ask in chat first. dict_list runs at once.

tools.name: rules
tools.description: Tidia's output rules: how the person wants their dictated messages shaped, e.g. text "Number the steps", when "the dictation lists several tasks". Without when, a rule always applies. Rules shape wording, register and layout; they never add content. Add a rule when the person asks; when they keep asking for the same shape, offer it by calling rule_add. rule_add takes scope global (default) or project. Starter rules (bug reports, feature requests, reviews, task lists, and a polite, casual or as-spoken register) are off until the person asks for one: turn it on with rule_update enabled true, off with enabled false; they cannot be reworded. rule_add, rule_update and rule_remove: They show the person a dialog where they allow or decline the change: call the action and do not ask in chat first. rule_list runs at once.

tools.name: settings
tools.description: Tidia's settings for cleaning up the person's voice dictation. The person speaks rather than types, so they change them by asking you. setting_get reads them; setting_set with key and value changes one: style = polish|minimal; english_terms = auto|off|low|medium|high; model = sonnet|haiku|opus; learn = ask|off; dict_approval = auto|ask; polish_on = enter|pause; message_view = tidied|labeled|full; bubble_labels = free text up to 80 characters, none to clear; debug = on|off; dictionary = on|off; attach_raw = on|off; ui_language = auto|en|ko|ja|zh|zh-TW|es|de|fr|pt|ru|hi|id; they are saved. off / on stop or resume cleaning for this session only; setting_get reports it as cleaning. setting_set: They show the person a dialog where they allow or decline the change: call the action and do not ask in chat first. The other actions run at once.
